normal.text: Was probably a flash in the pan, but I have no idea where this is all going now. If you want to play games, hopefully you have an old PC around that still works or an old console. Basically just hold on to what you have for as long as it keeps working

normal.text: I learned to soft-reset on a SNES before I could read. Pressing reset at the exact frame felt like magic—until I once saved mid-glitch and my hero fell forever. Kids today don’t know that fear. What’s your most cursed save?
